summary: The person accepting a campaign bouquet has to find somewhere for it to go after the candidate leaves.
realLife: Bray said the 1948 crew arranged for accumulated flowers to go to veterans hospitals or to a local hospital where there was no veterans facility.
inGame: needs: received flowers and an available recipient.

turns.pulledBy: A hospital can take the flowers.
turns.what: The helper arranges delivery after the event.
turns.writesBack: The bouquet reaches patients instead of traveling on.

turns.pulledBy: The intended hospital cannot accept them.
turns.what: The helper asks a local host for another recipient.
turns.writesBack: The host takes responsibility for the flowers.
